name: Monk
summary: Monks are united in their ability to magically harness the energy that flows in their bodies. Whether channeled as a striking display of combat prowess or a subtler focus of defensive ability and speed, this energy infuses all that a monk does.
multiclassRequirement: You must have a Dexterity score and a Wisdom score of 13 or higher in order to multiclass in or out of this class.

hitPoints.Hit Points at Higher Levels: 1d8 (or 5) + your Constitution modifier per monk level after 1st

proficiencies.Tools: Choose one type of artisan's tools or one musical instrument
proficiencies.Skills: Choose two from Acrobatics, Athletics, History, Insight, Religion, and Stealth

spellcastingTable.title: You must have a Dexterity score and a Wisdom score of 13 or higher in order to multiclass in or out of this class.
rows: Monastic Tradition, Deflect Missiles, Ki-Fueled Attack (Optional)
Ability Score Improvement, Slow Fall, Quickened Healing (Optional)

journeyStages.label: Class
journeyStages.summary: Choose a class and review its baseline combat profile.

journeyStages.label: Class Features
journeyStages.summary: Martial Arts, Ki and the rest of the monk's toolkit.

journeyStages.label: Equipment
journeyStages.summary: Choose your starting weapon and pack.

classFeatures.name: Unarmored Defense
keyFacts: No armor and no shield: AC = 10 + DEX + WIS.
classFeatures.summary: Beginning at 1st level, while you are wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.
classFeatures.short: Without armor or shield, AC = 10 + DEX + WIS.

classFeatures.name: Martial Arts
keyFacts: Use DEX instead of STR with unarmed strikes and monk weapons.
Roll your Martial Arts die for their damage.
Bonus action unarmed strike after the Attack action.
classFeatures.summary: At 1st level, your practice of martial arts gives you mastery of combat styles that use unarmed strikes and monk weapons, which are shortswords and any simple melee weapons that don't have the two-handed or heavy property. You gain the following benefits while you are unarmed or wielding only monk weapons and you aren't wearing armor or wielding a shield: You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of your unarmed strikes and monk weapons. You can roll a d4 in place of the normal damage of your unarmed strike or monk weapon. This die changes as you gain monk levels, as shown in the Martial Arts column of the Monk table. When you use the Attack action with an unarmed strike or a monk weapon on your turn, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action. For example, if you take the Attack action and attack with a quarterstaff, you can also make an unarmed strike as a bonus action, assuming you haven't already taken a bonus action this turn. Certain monasteries use specialized forms of the monk weapons. For example, you might use a club that is two lengths of wood connected by a short chain (called a nunchaku) or a sickle with a shorter, straighter blade (called a kama). Whatever name you use for a monk weapon, you can use the game statistics provided for the weapon on the Weapons page.
classFeatures.short: Fight with fists and monk weapons using DEX and your Martial Arts die.

classFeatures.name: Ki
keyFacts: Ki points equal to your monk level, regained on a short or long rest.
Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense and Step of the Wind cost 1 ki.
Ki save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + WIS.
classFeatures.summary: Starting at 2nd level, your training allows you to harness the mystic energy of ki. Your access to this energy is represented by a number of ki points. Your monk level determines the number of points you have, as shown in the Ki Points column of the Monk table. You can spend these points to fuel various ki features. You start knowing three such features: Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind. You learn more ki features as you gain levels in this class. When you spend a ki point, it is unavailable until you finish a short or long rest, at the end of which you draw all of your expended ki back into yourself. You must spend at least 30 minutes of the rest meditating to regain your ki points. Some of your ki features require your target to make a saving throw to resist the feature's effects. The saving throw DC is calculated as follows: Ki save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier Flurry of Blows. Immediately after you take the Attack action on your turn, you can spend 1 ki point to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action. Patient Defense. You can spend 1 ki point to take the Dodge action as a bonus action on your turn. Step of the Wind. You can spend 1 ki point to take the Disengage or Dash action as a bonus action on your turn, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.

grants.text: Flurry of Blows (1 ki): after the Attack action, two unarmed strikes as a bonus action.
Patient Defense (1 ki): Dodge as a bonus action. Step of the Wind (1 ki): Disengage or Dash as a bonus action, jump distance doubled.

classFeatures.short: Spend ki on Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense and Step of the Wind.

classFeatures.name: Unarmored Movement
keyFacts: Speed bonus while wearing no armor and no shield.

milestones.label: Move along vertical surfaces and across liquids

classFeatures.summary: Starting at 2nd level, your speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield. This bonus increases when you reach certain monk levels, as shown in the Monk table. At 9th level, you gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the move.
classFeatures.short: Move faster while unarmored; later run on walls and water.

classFeatures.name: Dedicated Weapon (Optional)
keyFacts: After a short or long rest, make one proficient simple or martial weapon (no heavy or special) a monk weapon.
classFeatures.summary: Also at 2nd level, you train yourself to use a variety of weapons as monk weapons, not just simple melee weapons and shortswords. Whenever you finish a short or long rest, you can touch one weapon, focus your ki on it, and then count that weapon as a monk weapon until you use this feature again. The chosen weapon must meet these criteria: The weapon must be a simple or martial weapon. You must be proficient with it. It must lack the heavy and special properties.
classFeatures.short: Make one proficient weapon count as a monk weapon.

classFeatures.name: Deflect Missiles
keyFacts: Reaction: reduce ranged weapon damage by 1d10 + DEX + monk level.
If reduced to 0 you can catch it and throw it back for 1 ki.
classFeatures.summary: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your reaction to deflect or catch the missile when you are hit by a ranged weapon attack. When you do so, the damage you take from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your monk level. If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the missile if it is small enough for you to hold in one hand and you have at least one hand free. If you catch a missile in this way, you can spend 1 ki point to make a ranged attack with a range of 20/60 using the weapon or piece of ammunition you just caught, as part of the same reaction. You make this attack with proficiency, regardless of your weapon proficiencies, and the missile counts as a monk weapon for the attack.

grants.text: Deflect Missiles (reaction): reduce ranged weapon damage by 1d10 + DEX + monk level; 1 ki to throw it back.

classFeatures.short: Reduce ranged weapon damage; catch and throw it back.

classFeatures.name: Ki-Fueled Attack (Optional)
keyFacts: After spending ki as part of your action, one unarmed strike or monk weapon attack as a bonus action.
classFeatures.summary: Also at 3rd level, if you spend 1 ki point or more as part of your action on your turn, you can make one attack with an unarmed strike or a monk weapon as a bonus action before the end of the turn.
classFeatures.short: After spending ki in your action, make one quick attack.

classFeatures.name: Ability Score Improvement
keyFacts: +2 to one ability or +1 to two, or a feat.
classFeatures.summary: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
classFeatures.short: Raise one ability by 2, two by 1, or take a feat.

classFeatures.name: Slow Fall
keyFacts: Reaction: reduce falling damage by 5 × monk level.
classFeatures.summary: Beginning at 4th level, you can use your reaction when you fall to reduce any falling damage you take by an amount equal to five times your monk level.

grants.text: Slow Fall (reaction): reduce falling damage by 5 × monk level.

classFeatures.short: Reduce falling damage by 5 × monk level.

classFeatures.name: Quickened Healing (Optional)
keyFacts: Action, 2 ki: regain HP equal to a Martial Arts die + proficiency bonus.
classFeatures.summary: Also at 4th level, as an action, you can spend 2 ki points and roll a Martial Arts die. You regain a number of hit points equal to the number rolled plus your proficiency bonus.
classFeatures.short: Heal a Martial Arts die + proficiency bonus.

classFeatures.name: Extra Attack
keyFacts: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
classFeatures.summary: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

grants.text: Extra Attack: attack twice when you take the Attack action.

classFeatures.short: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

classFeatures.name: Stunning Strike
keyFacts: On a melee weapon hit, spend 1 ki: CON save or stunned until the end of your next turn.
classFeatures.summary: Starting at 5th level, you can interfere with the flow of ki in an opponent's body. When you hit another creature with a melee weapon attack, you can spend 1 ki point to attempt a stunning strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

grants.text: Stunning Strike (1 ki): on a melee weapon hit, target makes a CON save against your ki DC or is stunned until the end of your next turn.

classFeatures.short: Spend 1 ki on a melee hit to stun the target.

facts.duration: Until end of your next turn

classFeatures.name: Focused Aim (Optional)
keyFacts: On a miss, spend 1-3 ki for +2 to the attack roll per ki.
classFeatures.summary: Also at 5th level, when you miss with an attack roll, you can spend 1 to 3 ki points to increase your attack roll by 2 for each of these ki points you spend, potentially turning the miss into a hit.
classFeatures.short: Turn a miss into a hit: +2 to the roll per ki.

classFeatures.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
keyFacts: Unarmed strikes count as magical.
classFeatures.summary: Starting at 6th level, your unarmed strikes count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

grants.text: Ki-Empowered Strikes: unarmed strikes count as magical.

classFeatures.short: Your unarmed strikes count as magical.

classFeatures.name: Evasion
keyFacts: DEX saves for half damage: no damage on success, half on failure.
classFeatures.summary: At 7th level, your instinctive agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain area effects, such as a blue dragon's lightning breath or a fireball spell. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

grants.text: Evasion: no damage on a successful DEX save for half damage, half on a failure.

classFeatures.short: Take no damage on a successful DEX save, half on a failure.

classFeatures.name: Stillness of Mind
keyFacts: Action: end one charmed or frightened effect on yourself.
classFeatures.summary: Starting at 7th level, you can use your action to end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be charmed or frightened.
classFeatures.short: End a charm or fear effect on yourself.

classFeatures.name: Purity of Body
keyFacts: Immune to disease and poison.
classFeatures.summary: At 10th level, your mastery of the ki flowing through you makes you immune to disease and poison.
classFeatures.short: Become immune to disease and poison.

classFeatures.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
keyFacts: Understand all spoken languages; any creature that knows a language understands you.
classFeatures.summary: Starting at 13th level, you learn to touch the ki of other minds so that you understand all spoken languages. Moreover, any creature that can understand a language can understand what you say.
classFeatures.short: Understand every spoken language and be understood.

classFeatures.name: Diamond Soul
keyFacts: Proficiency in all saving throws.
Spend 1 ki to reroll a failed save.
classFeatures.summary: Beginning at 14th level, your mastery of ki grants you proficiency in all saving throws. Additionally, whenever you make a saving throw and fail, you can spend 1 ki point to reroll it and take the second result.

grants.text: Diamond Soul: spend 1 ki to reroll a failed saving throw.

classFeatures.short: Gain proficiency in all saves; spend 1 ki to reroll one.

classFeatures.name: Timeless Body
keyFacts: No frailty of old age; no need for food or water.
classFeatures.summary: At 15th level, your ki sustains you so that you suffer none of the frailty of old age, and you can't be aged magically. You can still die of old age, however. In addition, you no longer need food or water.
classFeatures.short: Stop aging and no longer need food or water.

classFeatures.name: Empty Body
keyFacts: Action, 4 ki: invisible for 1 minute with resistance to all damage but force.
8 ki: cast Astral Projection on yourself.
classFeatures.summary: Beginning at 18th level, you can use your action to spend 4 ki points to become invisible for 1 minute. During that time, you also have resistance to all damage but force damage. Additionally, you can spend 8 ki points to cast the astral projection spell, without needing material components. When you do so, you can't take any other creatures with you.

grants.text: Empty Body (4 ki): invisible for 1 minute and resistance to all damage except force; 8 ki for Astral Projection.

classFeatures.short: Turn invisible and resist most damage for a minute.

classFeatures.name: Perfect Self
keyFacts: Regain 4 ki when you roll initiative with none left.
classFeatures.summary: At 20th level, when you roll for initiative and have no ki points remaining, you regain 4 ki points.

grants.text: Perfect Self: regain 4 ki when you roll initiative with no ki left.

classFeatures.short: Regain 4 ki when you roll initiative with none left.
